name: Verdant Hollow
introDialogue: The hollow's beasts have grown bold. Someone should thin them out.
Trappers speak of tracks bigger than any deer. Much bigger.
The old warden left a bounty board. Most notes just say 'please hurry.'
completionDialogue: The hollow breathes easier tonight. The beasts remember fear.
A trapper tips his hat. 'Didn't think you'd come back whole.'
The bounty board thins. New notes mention ruins to the east...

name: Gloomspire Ruins
introDialogue: The ruins hum with leftover arithmetic. The wards want feeding.
Scholars paid good coin to map the spire. None came back to collect.
Something in the gloom recites theorems backward. It knows you're here.
completionDialogue: The hum quiets. The spire's lesson, for now, is concluded.
You pocket a scholar's coin. He won't be needing the change.
The gloom recedes one floor. Above, something larger turns a page.
